title: Alternate play cost clause ('If you've spent [4] or more to play a spell this turn, you may play me for [mind]') is not implemented
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/jhin-meticulous-killer.ts:29-41 models the alt cost as a static grant-keyword "AltPlayCost", with a comment at lines 15-16 stating "The actual alt-cost mechanic is not in the Effect union; this captures the intent." grep for "AltPlayCost" across packages/riftbound-engine/src/ and apps/riftbound-app/server.ts returns zero hits — the engine has no handler, so playUnit only offers the base 4-energy cost.
observed: Only one playUnit variant offered; playing it deducted the full 4 energy (16->12, mind power unchanged). In a second game with energy=0 / mind=3 after spending 6 on Progress Day, no playUnit move was enumerated for Jhin and forcing it returned CONDITION_FAILED. Card def models this as a static grant-keyword 'AltPlayCost' which the engine has no handler for (no references outside card files).
